headline: MCBANK Selects Jack Henry to Power Relationship-Driven Banking
summary: Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) announced today that MCBANK has selected Jack Henry to support its long-term growth strategy, build its commercial banking capabilities, and deliver modern banking experiences as it expands across the Gulf South.
